entities.summary: Edi M. Shukriu was a Kosovan political figure, archaeologist, and writer. She wrote seven books of poetry. She was awarded the Dea Dardanciae award by the Kosovan Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports, and won the Beqir Musliu Literary Award, the Award of the Writers' Association of Kosovo, and the scientific book of the year award in 1996.
